title: What is Express.js?
overview: Express.js is a lightweight web framework built on Node.js. It simplifies creating servers, APIs, routes, and middleware.

example.title: Express Usage
example.content:
✔ Create servers
✔ Build REST APIs
✔ Handle routes
✔ Manage requests and responses

title: Installing Express
overview: Express is installed as an external npm package and added as a dependency in a Node.js project.

title: Creating Express Server
overview: Express provides methods to create a server that listens for client requests and sends responses.

example.title: Express Server Example

title: Express Routing
overview: Routing defines how an application responds to different URLs and HTTP methods.

title: Request and Response Objects
overview: Express provides request and response objects to access incoming data and send responses back to clients.

title: Middleware in Express
overview: Middleware functions execute between receiving a request and sending a response. They are used for authentication, logging, and data processing.

title: Express Router
overview: Express Router helps organize routes into separate files, making large applications easier to maintain.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned Express.js basics including server creation, routing, request handling, middleware, and route organization.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Express simplifies Node.js development.
✔ Routes handle requests.
✔ Middleware processes requests.
✔ Router organizes APIs.
